Students belonging to the ST category securing admission at MNIT with a family income up to INR 6 LPA are granted the scholarship

Candidates belonging to minor communities (Muslim, Sikh, Parsi, Buddhist, Jain, Christian) with a total family income up to INR 2.5 LPA
Candidates must have secured a minimum of 50% aggregate in 10+2
Post-matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
Candidates with a physical disability with a total family income of up to INR 2.5 LPA are granted the scholarship
Candidates must have 40% disability with a valid certificate under the rules specified by the competent authority
Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
Candidates from all the categories with family income up to INR 4.5 LPA can benefit from the scholarship.
Candidates must have secured 80% in 10+2 and should be between 18-25 years old
Special scholarship for Jammu and Kashmir
The scholarship is granted to students from Jammu & Kashmir with a total family income of up to INR 8 LPA.
Based on the merit in the 12th grade from the State Board.
A special scholarship is offered only for foreign students with an income less than USD 5000 (for NRIs/PIOs/OCIs) and USD 3000 (for children of Indian workers in ECR countries).
